dependency_note: D14 cost measurements must be interpreted against D12's semantic frontier and D13's replay-sufficiency findings. No compute saving is valid if it removes a D12-required distinction.
governing_workload_law: RECONSTRUCTIBILITY is required for the future-authorized query/discovery frontier.
Bounded exact contingencies may satisfy bounded fixed queries.
Autonomous discovery requires a governed candidate frontier; the winning relationship need not be individually predeclared.
Benchmark both successful-result and typed-empty/noncomparable/no-support paths where they carry terminal semantics.

benchmark_families.shape: One target question, one exact empirical coordinate/value conditioner, one source/universe/scope, exact risk set and measure.
benchmark_families.semantic_success: Exact conditional distribution/support/risk-set/measure/provenance or exact typed zero/no-support state.

benchmark_families.shape: Authorized conjunction of 2..k empirical coordinates conditioning one or more response targets.
benchmark_families.semantic_success: Exact conjunction result without multiplying independent marginals.

benchmark_families.shape: One governed same-respondent response pair under exact common/declared risk set.
benchmark_families.semantic_success: Complete contingency; diagnostic calculation cost reported separately from deep-fact reconstruction.

benchmark_families.shape: Exact requested k-way joint response configuration under fixed conditioner/risk-set/scope.
benchmark_families.mandatory_fixture: parity/XOR case where lower-order marginals are insufficient
benchmark_families.semantic_success: Exact support/mass including all supported nonmodal cells and explicit observed-zero/typed-unavailable distinctions.

benchmark_families.shape: Search a governed candidate frontier containing a low-frequency but supported non-top response/social configuration.
benchmark_families.semantic_success: Candidate remains reachable and output preserves support/uncertainty rather than suppressing it into absence.

benchmark_families.shape: Autonomously search a bounded lawful coordinate/conjunction frontier where the winning interaction is not individually named.
required_variants: strong all-pair interaction excluding strongest unary
benchmark_families.semantic_success: Discovery coverage matches declared authority/algorithm coverage claim; pruning does not silently become semantic absence.

benchmark_families.shape: Data-selected first fork followed by secondary/tertiary candidate search inside discovered cohorts.
benchmark_families.semantic_success: Exact branch predicates/membership replay and claimed candidate coverage; no requirement to persist a historical tree artifact.

benchmark_families.shape: One discovered/replayed branch cohort crossed with one or more same-respondent response targets.
benchmark_families.semantic_success: Exact branch membership/predicate plus complete conditioned contingency.

benchmark_families.shape: Representative bounded full forward discovery run over governed question/coordinate/response candidate universe.
required_scenarios: larger frontier requiring lawful pruning/coverage contract
benchmark_families.semantic_success: Same governed frontier and deterministic replay inputs reproduce same coverage/result/typed-empty outcome.

benchmark_families.shape: Generated subject with one exact comparable property selecting one survey conditioner and one target question.
benchmark_families.semantic_success: Exact comparator receipt and unary possibility field or typed fail-closed state.

benchmark_families.shape: Generated subject with multiple comparable properties selecting an exact conjunction; requested target arity 2..k.
benchmark_families.semantic_success: Exact conditional joint field; no independence assumption and no direct actor-state assignment.
Exact predicate or typed no-match/ambiguity; no fuzzy/string/geographic-nearest fallback.

benchmark_families.shape: Comparable facts across multiple waves/periods with preserved source identities.
benchmark_families.semantic_success: Temporal distinction preserved with exact comparability/proxy provenance.

benchmark_families.shape: Compute comparable source-indexed facts for two or more distinct universes and compare without respondent joining/pooling unless separately authorized.
benchmark_families.semantic_success: Source-indexed components and disagreement/noncomparability state survive.

benchmark_families.shape: Produce/replay empirical fact required by an exact structural producer/admission rule, then measure transformation/admission cost separately from empirical reconstruction.
benchmark_families.semantic_success: Producer receives exact authorized empirical fact/provenance and preserves negative authority.

benchmark_families.shape: Queries containing routed/not-asked, DK/refusal/IAP, multiselect/repeated responses and differing denominator semantics.
benchmark_families.semantic_success: Typed states and multiplicity remain distinct; no scalar first-row or blank collapse changes meaning.

benchmark_families.shape: Regenerate selected derived distribution/cloud/association/tree/search views from the D13-approved deeper information carrier.
benchmark_families.purpose: Measure the cost of not permanently materializing derived artifacts; this workload does not make those artifacts terminally required.
benchmark_families.semantic_success: Derived result matches its exact declared algorithm/authority semantics where replay is requested.

comparison_baselines_D14_may_measure_wit: on-demand exact bounded query over whichever D13-approved carrier is under evaluation
mandatory_cost_dimensions: cold versus warm/cache-assisted execution where applicable
D14_must_not_conclude: a capability is unnecessary because it is expensive
a materialized artifact is required because recomputation is expensive
a cheaper approximate representation is acceptable if it violates D12 information equivalence
current workload defaults are target authority
one benchmarked algorithm family is architecturally selected
all permitted queries must be precomputed
no populated support problem exists merely because no live DB is available
expected_D14_output_shape: For each workload family and scaling point: semantic target, authority/coverage assumptions, carrier tested after D13, cost measurements, output cardinality, replay/accuracy equivalence status, and explicit separation of terminal work from optional diagnostic/materialization work.
architecture_gate: D14 may report cost frontiers and dominant cost drivers. It may not select the replacement architecture; D15 remains first architecture-synthesis court.
